parameters.sqlQuery:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `gelsa-datarutas-prod.formularios.log_notificaciones_monitoreo_noche` (
  visitID STRING NOT NULL,
  chat_id STRING NOT NULL,
  estado STRING NOT NULL,
  fecha_envio TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `gelsa-datarutas-prod.formularios.log_notificaciones_telegram` (
  visitID STRING NOT NULL,
  fecha_envio TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  estado STRING NOT NULL
);
WITH visitas_recaudo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        t.event_id,
        t.visit_point_identification,
        t.visit_point_name
    FROM `gelsa-datarutas-prod.formularios.visitas_gelsa` AS t
    WHERE UPPER(TRIM(t.activity_name)) = 'RECAUDO ESCOLTAS'
),

respuestas AS (
    SELECT
        t.event_id,
        t.visitID,
        t.formID,
        t.userName,
        CAST(t.initDate AS DATE) AS initDate,
        t.initHour,
        t.endHour,
        t.status,
        a.question,

        CASE
            WHEN a.question IS NULL THEN NULL

            -- Consultas 4 y 5
            WHEN t.formID IN (
                '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5',
                '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            )
            THEN COALESCE(
                NULLIF(a.answer, ''),
                (
                    SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(
                        ARRAY_AGG(
                            STRUCT(
                                c.key AS pregunta,
                                c.value AS respuesta
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    FROM UNNEST(a.answers) AS c
                )
            )

            -- Consultas 1, 2, 3 y 6
            ELSE COALESCE(
                NULLIF(a.answer, ''),
                (
                    SELECT STRING_AGG(c.key, ', ')
                    FROM UNNEST(a.answers) AS c
                    WHERE c.value = 'True'
                )
            )
        END AS respuesta

    FROM `gelsa-datarutas-prod.tablas_json.formularios_json` AS t

    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(t.form) AS f

    LEFT JOIN UNNEST(f.answers) AS a
        ON (

            -- ============================================================
            -- CONSULTA 1 - FORMULARIO PRINCIPAL
            -- ============================================================
            (
                t.formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb'
                AND a.question IN (
                    'C?DULA RESPONSABLE ENTREGA CDA',
                    'LUGAR DE ENTREGA',
                    'NOMBRE RESPONSABLE ENTREGA CDA',
                    'NOVEDAD',
                    'OBSERVACIONES ADICIONALES',
                    'NOVEDAD RECAUDO',
                    'TIPO DE RECAUDO',
                    'TIPO DE TRASLADO'
                )
            )

            OR

            -- ============================================================
            -- CONSULTA 2 - CDA RECAUDO
            -- ============================================================
            (
                t.formID = '685ca4211f5a4e37891798f62256d5ee'
                AND a.question IN (
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CDA',
                    'VALOR BOLSA CDA',
                    'TIPO DE EFECTIVO CDA',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CDA'
                )
            )

            OR

            -- ============================================================
            -- CONSULTA 3 - DISTRIBUCI?N RECAUDO
            -- ============================================================
            (
                t.formID = '303d00c79f304234b0ec3bb3ec7a2806'
                AND a.question IN (
                    'SERIAL BOLSA DISTR.',
                    'DISTRIBUCI?N BOLSAS',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA DISTR.',
                    'NOVEDAD DISTR.',
                    'VALOR BOLSA DISTR.',
                    'COMPROBANTE BOLSA DISTR.',
                    'TIPO DE EFECTIVO DISTRIBUCI?N'
                )
            )

            OR

            -- ============================================================
            -- CONSULTA 4 - CAJA ENTREGA
            -- ============================================================
            (
                t.formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
                AND a.question IN (
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 1',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 2',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 3',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 4',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 5',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 6',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 7',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 8',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 9',
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 10',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 1',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 2',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 3',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 4',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 5',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 6',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 7',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 8',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 9',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 10'
                )
            )

            OR

            -- ============================================================
            -- CONSULTA 5 - TESORER?A ENTREGA
            -- ============================================================
            (
                t.formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
                AND a.question IN (
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 1',
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 2',
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 3',
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 4',
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 5',
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 6',
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 7',
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 8',
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 9',
                    'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 10',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 1',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 2',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 3',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 4',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 5',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 6',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 7',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 8',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 9',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 10'
                )
            )

            OR

            -- ============================================================
            -- CONSULTA 6 - CAJA RECAUDO
            -- ============================================================
            (
                t.formID = '03e72748ced54ae88100db5610732f8e'
                AND a.question IN (
                    'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA',
                    'SERIAL BOLSA',
                    'VALOR BOLSA',
                    'TIPO DE EFECTIVO'
                )
            )
        )

    WHERE
        t.companyName = 'GRUPO EMPRESARIAL EN LINEA S.A'

        AND t.formID IN (
            '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb',
            '685ca4211f5a4e37891798f62256d5ee',
            '303d00c79f304234b0ec3bb3ec7a2806',
            '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5',
            '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1',
            '03e72748ced54ae88100db5610732f8e'
        )

        -- ============================================================
        -- SOLO VISITAS REALIZADAS HOY - HORA COLOMBIA
        -- ============================================================
        AND CAST(t.initDate AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE('America/Bogota')
),

consulta_grande AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        visitID,

        -- ================================================================
        -- CONSULTA 1
        -- ================================================================

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb',
            userName,
            NULL
        )) AS userName,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb',
            initDate,
            NULL
        )) AS initDate,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb',
            initHour,
            NULL
        )) AS initHour,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb',
            endHour,
            NULL
        )) AS endHour,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb',
            status,
            NULL
        )) AS status,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb'
            AND question = 'C?DULA RESPONSABLE ENTREGA CDA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS CEDULA_RESPONSABLE_ENTREGA_CDA,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb'
            AND question = 'LUGAR DE ENTREGA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS LUGAR_DE_ENTREGA,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb'
            AND question = 'NOMBRE RESPONSABLE ENTREGA CDA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS NOMBRE_RESPONSABLE_ENTREGA_CDA,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb'
            AND question = 'NOVEDAD',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS NOVEDAD,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb'
            AND question = 'OBSERVACIONES ADICIONALES',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS OBSERVACIONES_ADICIONALES,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb'
            AND question = 'NOVEDAD RECAUDO',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS NOVEDAD_RECAUDO,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb'
            AND question = 'TIPO DE RECAUDO',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS TIPO_DE_RECAUDO,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '7eebc16e40694595a2cd3cde7e8adfeb'
            AND question = 'TIPO DE TRASLADO',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS TIPO_DE_TRASLADO,

        -- ================================================================
        -- CONSULTA 2
        -- ================================================================

STRING_AGG(
  DISTINCT IF(
            formID = '685ca4211f5a4e37891798f62256d5ee'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CDA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS ESCANER_SERIAL_BOLSA_CDA,

STRING_AGG(
  DISTINCT IF(
            formID = '685ca4211f5a4e37891798f62256d5ee'
            AND question = 'VALOR BOLSA CDA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS VALOR_BOLSA_CDA,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '685ca4211f5a4e37891798f62256d5ee'
            AND question = 'TIPO DE EFECTIVO CDA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS TIPO_DE_EFECTIVO_CDA,

STRING_AGG(
  DISTINCT IF(
            formID = '685ca4211f5a4e37891798f62256d5ee'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CDA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS SERIAL_BOLSA_CDA,

        -- ================================================================
        -- CONSULTA 3
        -- ================================================================

STRING_AGG(
  DISTINCT IF(
            formID = '303d00c79f304234b0ec3bb3ec7a2806'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA DISTR.',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS SERIAL_BOLSA_DISTR,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '303d00c79f304234b0ec3bb3ec7a2806'
            AND question = 'DISTRIBUCI?N BOLSAS',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS DISTRIBUCION_BOLSAS,

STRING_AGG(
  DISTINCT IF(
            formID = '303d00c79f304234b0ec3bb3ec7a2806'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA DISTR.',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS ESCANER_SERIAL_BOLSA_DISTR,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '303d00c79f304234b0ec3bb3ec7a2806'
            AND question = 'NOVEDAD DISTR.',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS NOVEDAD_DISTR,

STRING_AGG(
  DISTINCT IF(
            formID = '303d00c79f304234b0ec3bb3ec7a2806'
            AND question = 'VALOR BOLSA DISTR.',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS VALOR_BOLSA_DISTR,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '303d00c79f304234b0ec3bb3ec7a2806'
            AND question = 'COMPROBANTE BOLSA DISTR.',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS COMPROBANTE_BOLSA_DISTR,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '303d00c79f304234b0ec3bb3ec7a2806'
            AND question = 'TIPO DE EFECTIVO DISTRIBUCI?N',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS TIPO_DE_EFECTIVO_DISTRIBUCION,

        -- ================================================================
        -- CONSULTA 4 - CAJA
        -- ================================================================

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 1', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_1,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 2', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_2,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 3', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_3,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 4', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_4,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 5', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_5,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 6', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_6,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 7', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_7,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 8', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_8,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 9', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_9,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 10', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_SERIAL_10,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 1', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_1,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 2', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_2,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 3', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_3,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 4', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_4,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 5', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_5,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 6', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_6,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 7', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_7,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 8', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_8,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 9', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_9,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '78949562d1114523b9f57bed329ef9f5'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA CAJA 10', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_10,

        -- ================================================================
        -- CONSULTA 5 - TESORER?A
        -- ================================================================

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 1', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_1,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 2', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_2,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 3', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_3,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 4', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_4,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 5', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_5,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 6', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_6,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 7', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_7,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 8', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_8,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 9', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_9,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER BOLSA TESORER?A 10', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS ESCANER_BOLSA_10,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 1', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_1,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 2', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_2,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 3', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_3,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 4', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_4,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 5', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_5,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 6', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_6,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 7', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_7,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 8', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_8,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 9', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_9,

        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT IF(formID = '2a7a873e535b491bb64190a61e2a18b1'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA TESORER?A 10', respuesta, NULL), ' ? ') AS SERIAL_BOLSA_TESORERIA_10,

        -- ================================================================
        -- CONSULTA 6 - CAJA RECAUDO
        -- ================================================================

STRING_AGG(
  DISTINCT IF(
            formID = '03e72748ced54ae88100db5610732f8e'
            AND question = 'ESC?NER SERIAL BOLSA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS ESCANER_SERIAL_BOLSA,

STRING_AGG(
  DISTINCT IF(
            formID = '03e72748ced54ae88100db5610732f8e'
            AND question = 'SERIAL BOLSA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS SERIAL_BOLSA,

STRING_AGG(
  DISTINCT IF(
            formID = '03e72748ced54ae88100db5610732f8e'
            AND question = 'VALOR BOLSA',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS VALOR_BOLSA,

        MAX(IF(
            formID = '03e72748ced54ae88100db5610732f8e'
            AND question = 'TIPO DE EFECTIVO',
            respuesta,
            NULL
        )) AS TIPO_DE_EFECTIVO

    FROM respuestas

    GROUP BY
        event_id,
        visitID
)
,
usuarios_monitoreo AS (
  SELECT
    Chat_ID,
    Nombre_Usuario
  FROM `gelsa-datarutas-prod.formularios.usuarios_notificaciones`
  WHERE UPPER(TRIM(Roll)) = 'MONITOREO'
    AND activo = TRUE
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(Chat_ID), '') IS NOT NULL
),

candidato AS (
  SELECT
    q.*,
    v.visit_point_identification,
    v.visit_point_name
  FROM consulta_grande AS q
  LEFT JOIN visitas_recaudo AS v
    ON q.event_id = v.event_id
  CROSS JOIN usuarios_monitoreo AS um
  LEFT JOIN `gelsa-datarutas-prod.formularios.log_notificaciones_monitoreo_noche` AS ln
    ON ln.visitID = CAST(q.visitID AS STRING)
   AND ln.chat_id = um.Chat_ID

SELECT
  q.*, v.visit_point_identification, v.visit_point_name,
  m.monitor_chat_id, FORMAT_TIME('%H:%M', CURRENT_TIME('America/Bogota')) AS corte
FROM consulta_grande AS q
LEFT JOIN visitas_recaudo AS v ON q.event_id = v.event_id
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT Chat_ID AS monitor_chat_id
  FROM `gelsa-datarutas-prod.formularios.usuarios_notificaciones`
  WHERE (UPPER(TRIM(Roll)) = 'MONITOREO' OR UPPER(TRIM(userName)) = 'PRUEBAS2')

) AS m

  AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(q.status, ''))) IN ('finished', 'finalizado')
  AND SAFE_CAST(CAST(q.endHour AS STRING) AS TIME) >= IF(CURRENT_TIME('America/Bogota') >= TIME '19:00:00', TIME '13:00:00', TIME '05:00:00')
  AND SAFE_CAST(CAST(q.endHour AS STRING) AS TIME) <= CURRENT_TIME('America/Bogota')
ORDER BY q.initDate, q.endHour, q.visitID;
